maya: Heads up — PR ready for hotfix merge, target cutover in 25m. Need a second reviewer to take over; current approvals: @sam approved. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/8476 Please ping if you can take it.

sam: I already added one approve but CI showed a flaky test, just kicked a rerun... smoke passed locally for me.

chris: On it. Quick question — does this touch kv-cache warmup? Any risk for the canary path?

maya: Small tweak to warmup ordering, low risk, but ops want 2nd signoff before cutover. If we miss cutoff we queue for next window.

leo: I can review in ~8m. I'll run `./scripts/smoke.sh` and report back.

deploy-bot: automated: deploy-cutoff scheduled at 2026-03-18T23:45:00Z (in ~24m).

sam: CI rerun is green now — summary: "All tests passed" (build 8476.2)

leo: Ran smoke locally, no errors. Left one minor nit in PR but non-blocking. LGTM :thumbsup:

chris: Thanks @leo — LGTM from me as well after the nit is addressed.

maya: Awesome, merging in 2m and will watch rollout. Thanks everyone :rocket:
